description: native-21 band-A arrangement (D-36): board in the front-middle band; BR1+FET row compressed onto the board's REAR edge right of the sensor corridor; edge sink under the coil support plate; right-wall inlet, rear-wall exhaust left of the mains connector blank. Board is L-shaped: main 290x140 plus a 91x50 tongue under the power core (world x 50..141, y 46..96); in the tongue, parts <= 22 mm above the board top for y < 76 (knob mechanism above Z 52), full height for y >= 76.
